intro: December is Ghana’s busiest month for things to do. Christmas, end-of-year concerts, street carnivals, food markets, plays and traditional festivals all fall in a few weeks, and many Ghanaians who live abroad come home for them, along with visitors from across the African diaspora.[[1]]

The government runs the season as December in GH, through the Ghana Tourism Authority. This year it runs from 1 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 under the theme “Ghana to the World”, with more than 150 events registered, over 100 of them in Accra.[[2,3]] Many people call it Detty December; the government prefers its own name.[[4]]

The season grew after Ghana’s 2019 Year of Return, which marked 400 years since enslaved Africans were first brought to North America.[[1]] Below are the events we’ve listed so far, in date order, with what to expect at each.
know: Fri 4 Dec (Farmers’ Day), Fri 25 Dec (Christmas Day), Sat 26 Dec (Boxing Day) and Fri 1 Jan (New Year’s Day).[[5,6]]
The harmattan, a dry and dusty north-easterly wind, can blow from November to March. Mornings can be hazy and cool.[[7]]
Most events are in Accra. This list also has events in Takoradi, Tamale, Ho, Koforidua, Bolgatanga, Sandema, Kumasi, Cape Coast and Sunyani.
It is the busiest travel time of the year, so book flights and rooms early, and check an event’s details again shortly before you go.

faq.a: A popular name for the end-of-year party season in Ghana and Nigeria. “Detty” is pidgin for “dirty”, used here to mean carefree fun. The Ghanaian government does not use the name: its season is called December in GH.[[1,4]]
From 1 December 2026 to 3 January 2027. The Ghana Tourism Authority launched this year’s calendar on 20 October 2026 at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra.[[2]]

faq.q: What’s on in Ghana in December?
faq.a: Concerts and parties, street carnivals and masquerades, food markets, plays, art weeks, sport, and traditional festivals such as Fiok in Sandema and Kwafie in the Bono Region. Our list on this page has 116 events in date order.
No. Most events are in Accra, but this season’s list also has events in Takoradi, Tamale, Ho, Koforidua, Bolgatanga, Sandema, Kumasi, Cape Coast and Sunyani.

faq.q: Which days are public holidays in December?
faq.a: In 2026: Friday 4 December (Farmers’ Day, always the first Friday of December), Friday 25 December (Christmas Day) and Saturday 26 December (Boxing Day). New Year’s Day, Friday 1 January 2027, is also a public holiday.[[5,6]]

faq.q: What is the weather like in December?
faq.a: It is harmattan season, when a dry, dusty wind can blow from November to March. Visibility can drop, especially early in the morning, and the dust can set off asthma, so carry water and something warm for early starts.[[7]]

For most concerts and parties, yes. Some events are free, and our cards say so where the organisers do. For tickets and the latest details, use the December in GH listing credited at the end of this page.
